context.body: Command and promise launch a journey whose results are not immediate.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD commands Abram to leave and promises land, nation, blessing, and a wider blessing through him.
observations.label: God calls Abram away: action

observations.body: Abram goes, enters Canaan, builds altars, and calls on the LORD’s name.
observations.label: God calls Abram away: response

observations.body: go · I will · bless · all families
observations.label: Words in Genesis 12:1–9

payload.posture: Read Genesis 12:1–9 as promise and the patriarchs evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage does not explain why Abram is chosen from among the nations named before him.
payload.title: God calls Abram away
